bugs.test_case_title: Search with no matching term shows empty state
bugs.title: [BUG][UR-655] Event Types search filter does not hide non-matching records
bugs.description: The search/quick-filter input on the Event Types list page (#setup-header-grid-quick-search) does not filter the AG Grid data when a search term is entered that matches no existing event type name.
steps_to_reproduce: Log in to staging.247software.com with Pranay / Pranay@1234
In the search input (#setup-header-grid-quick-search), enter: XYZNONEXISTENT999
bugs.expected_result: Grid shows empty state (0 rows) or a 'No results found' message since no event type name matches 'XYZNONEXISTENT999'
bugs.actual_result: Grid continues to display all existing event type records (e.g., '24/7 Mode') regardless of the non-matching search term entered
bugs.impact: Users cannot effectively search/filter the Event Types list. This is a usability defect that affects list navigation when many event types exist.

playwright_evidence.detail: Visible non-empty rows: 1. Contents: [{"text":"24/7 Mode\n24/7 Mode is used for your day","visible":true}]
